data.narrative:
Kreios Space is a Seed-stage aerospace company that has raised €8M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though the narrow peer set at Seed stage limits direct benchmarking.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: Stage-Progression anchoring. Using the €8M total raised as a proxy for current value, a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier applied to the Seed-to-next-stage transition yields an implied valuation of €20M. This reflects observed progression rates in early-stage venture financings but does not incorporate sector-specific dynamics. Peer-Median comparison was inapplicable due to insufficient datapoints in the narrow Seed-stage subset (1 identified, below the 3-peer minimum threshold for statistical confidence). Public-Comp Anchoring using the sector's 27.4x P/S median could not be executed absent disclosed revenue figures, standard for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €17M–€23M, centered on €20M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological leg and absence of revenue or profitability anchors. Key uncertainties include the target's actual revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and sector-specific risk appetite at Seed stage. Additional disclosure of near-term revenue or customer traction would enable revenue-multiple and comparable-company methods.
